events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday on September 21st.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: Still rocking at 54, the one and only Liam Gallagher celebrates his birthday. What's your favourite tune from the iconic frontman?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released 55 years ago on October 1, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine 55th Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music listening.

angles.name: iPod 25th Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember when music went from your CD player to your pocket? The first iPod was unveiled 25 years ago, changing how we listened forever.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab a martini, shaken not stirred! It's Global James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007. What's your favourite Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Visionary musician and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday on October 9th.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday on October 27th.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, the incomparable John Cleese turns 87 today. A true master of British comedy!

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album 58th Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, diverse 'White Album'. Which track from this epic double LP is your absolute favourite?

events.title: 35 years since we lost Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: November 24th marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, the world lost a voice like no other. Remembering the unparalleled showmanship and talent of Freddie Mercury.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul 61st Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly marked a shift in their sound. What's your top track from this classic?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's death
events.blurb: December 8th marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon in New York City.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on from his untimely passing. His music and legacy continue to resonate globally.
